title: fix: add DeepInfra to improve GLM 5.3 fallback
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: GLM 5.3 now has a hidden, fallback-only direct DeepInfra route between Fireworks and OpenRouter’s Friendli route, giving requests another path when an upstream fails. The route uses zai-org/GLM-5.3 with a 64,000-token default maximum and the existing mandatory-reasoning behavior. It supports parallel tool calls but excludes logprobs and top_logprobs. DeepInfra credentials now come from Worker environment bindings. The Privacy Policy and subprocessor list document the retry order and the request content passed to fallback providers.

She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; chunky sprites, a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, and a warm CRT glow make the scene nostalgic but beautiful.
